title: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 fails to escape backslashes in Liquidsoap annotation values, allowing media managers to break…
description: AzuraCast versions prior to 0.24.1 contain a vulnerability where backslashes in Liquidsoap annotation values are not properly escaped. This flaw allows media managers to break out of quoted annotation strings by crafting an ID3 title ending with a backslash, enabling injection of a process: protocol URI. Successful exploitation results in OS command execution within the Liquidsoap container during media playback.
